items.title: Ninety One reports £4.2bn net outflows in half-year results as shares fall 9%
items.summary: Ninety One experienced a share price fall following half-year results showing net outflows of £4.2bn.

items.title: Cyber insurance cover gaps exposed by supermarket and crypto attacks
items.summary: Recent cyber incidents have highlighted gaps between standard policy wordings and the physical and financial losses businesses face.

items.title: LCCI and Europa pension schemes complete buy-ins with Just Retirement
items.summary: Two pension schemes have secured member benefits through buy-in transactions with Just Retirement.

items.title: US air traffic control outage highlights systemic travel insurance and disruption risks
items.summary: A nationwide ground stop across US airports brings renewed focus to aviation resilience, consumer care obligations and travel policy exclusions.

items.title: Pedestrians account for 45% of serious injuries in Hastings Direct motor claims data
items.summary: Analysis of almost 4,500 claims reveals a sharp injury severity gap for vulnerable road users that carries direct implications for motor claims costs.

items.title: Government commits to new legal protections for face-to-face banking
items.summary: HM Treasury has accepted independent recommendations to legislate for in-person banking services following a review into consumer access.
